# Nikita Boyarkin — Data Analyst / Product Analyst Portfolio

> Portfolio of Nikita Boyarkin: SQL, Python, A/B testing, retention, segmentation. Project case studies with reproducible methodology (CUPED, AA-tests, ship-gates) and a skill taxonomy. RU (default) + EN.

## Core pages
- [Home (RU)](https://nikitaboyarkin.github.io/Personal_Projects.github.io/): intro, featured project (Volta neobank analytics), skill taxonomy, materials strip.
- [Home (EN)](https://nikitaboyarkin.github.io/Personal_Projects.github.io/en/): English mirror.
- [Writing](https://nikitaboyarkin.github.io/Personal_Projects.github.io/writing/): articles on SQL, A/B testing, segmentation, automation.
- [Skill taxonomy](https://nikitaboyarkin.github.io/Personal_Projects.github.io/topics/): Junior/Middle/Senior topics with case studies per topic.

## Featured project
- [Volta Banking analytics](https://nikitaboyarkin.github.io/Personal_Projects.github.io/projects/volta/): neobank funnel, A/B test, retention, segmentation — 4 modules.

## Other projects
- [RFM segmentation](https://nikitaboyarkin.github.io/Personal_Projects.github.io/projects/rfm/): customer RFM segmentation.
- [Cohort analysis](https://nikitaboyarkin.github.io/Personal_Projects.github.io/projects/cohort/): retention cohorts.
- [Telegram reporting bot](https://nikitaboyarkin.github.io/Personal_Projects.github.io/projects/bot/): automated reporting.
- [SQL reference](https://nikitaboyarkin.github.io/Personal_Projects.github.io/projects/sql/): SQL patterns.
